name: Social Scavenger
description: Picks through the wreckage of failed relationships for useful contacts
behavioral_signature: Shows up right after a breakup, firing, or fallout to befriend the leftovers
under_stress: Becomes transparent in their opportunism and gets called out
at_rest: Monitoring which relationships are about to end
will_always: be there when a group fractures
will_never: try to prevent a useful collapse
unless: the group intact serves them better than the pieces
